name: grill-me
title_zh: 像面试官一样拷问你的方案，直到想清楚
tagline_zh: 方案越重要，越该被狠问。它顺着你的决策树逐支追问，不放过任何含糊假设，直到你亲口说出「原来这里我没想明白」。
tagline_en: The more critical the plan, the harder it should be probed. It walks each branch of your decision tree until you.
desc_en: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, challenge an approach, or mentions "grill me".
why_zh: 它不是泛泛提意见，而是递归拆解每个决策分支，逼你为每个假设负责。像最较真的同事，但不会累。
why_en: It doesn't give generic advice—it recursively decomposes every decision branch, forcing you to own each assumption. Like your.
limit_zh: 只适用于有明确决策树的计划或设计；若目标模糊、无分支可拆，它会反复问同一层问题直到你烦。产物是共识与澄清。
limit_en: Only works on plans with a clear decision tree; vague goals make it loop on the same layer. Output is shared understanding, not docs or code.
